The supplied picture shows a driver in a red jacket.
Sampled frames of the source clip show a concrete road tunnel with overhead sodium strip lights.
Sampled frames of the source clip show a driver in a grey overall crossing frame left to right.
Sampled frames of the source clip show a black sports car with a carbon fibre body.
The red-jacketed driver waits at the tunnel edge; the car's headlights snap on; reflected light pools under the car.
Low tunnel ambience, a headlight relay click, rolling tyres and a rising engine note accompany the action.

description.text: The concrete road tunnel is almost black, with overhead sodium strip lights receding into haze. The
sits in shadow, its carbon fibre body only faintly catching the glow, the low nose and wide haunches held still. At the tunnel's edge, the

stands still, turned toward the car, the red jacket muted in the half-light. The car's wide tyres rest on the concrete, and a faint pool of reflected light lies under the front splitter. The dark space between them holds the frame open, the strip lights making a narrow path down the concrete, and the car's headlights are still off.
Overhead sodium strip lights recede into darkness; the
is a low silhouette in shadow, the tunnel walls catching only a thin sheen.
Low tunnel ambience and a faint electrical hum from the strip lights.
The
's headlights snap on, twin beams cutting down the tunnel and carving the car's shape out of the dark, the light spreading over the concrete.
The beams reach the far concrete, picking out the receding strip lights and the tunnel's damp sheen.
The headlight relay click settles into the strip-light hum.
The
pulls forward, rolling out of the shadow and through the pools of sodium light. The
crosses from left to right beside it, the grey overall catching the strip lights as he moves, his path steady and unhurried. At the tunnel's edge, the

holds position and watches the car go, the red jacket a fixed point against the concrete. The driver in grey keeps his shoulders square, one hand loose at his side, while the red-jacketed figure stays turned toward the moving car. The car advances until it fills more of the strip-lit exposure, its beams sweeping the tunnel walls and its carbon fibre body drawing a hard highlight along the flank.
The
begins to pull forward out of the dark, tyres rolling over the concrete.
Tyres roll on concrete; the engine note rises.
The
crosses from left to right beside the car, his grey overall passing through the sodium-light pools and his stride carrying him clear of the front wing.
The
moves into full strip-lit exposure, beams sweeping across the tunnel walls; the
stays at the edge, red jacket held in the sodium glow.
